# Pre-launch audit: Ledgerly docs ## Established defects 1. **`api.html`: canonical URL points to the wrong host** - Defect: The canonical is on `ledgerly.example`, but the site, sitemap and `index.html` canonical all use `docs.ledgerly.example`. Search engines may treat the canonical as a different site and drop this page from the docs host's index. The sitemap lists the page under a different URL than its canonical. - Evidence: - `api.html`: `` - `sitemap.xml`: `https://docs.ledgerly.example/api` - `index.html`: `https://docs.ledgerly.example/` 2. **`api.html`: title is copied from the home page and doesn't describe the page** - Defect: The title is "Ledgerly docs — getting started", but the page is the API reference. Two pages now share the same title, and the API page is mislabeled in tabs, bookmarks and search results. - Evidence: - `api.html`: `Ledgerly docs — getting started` with `

API reference

` - `index.html`: identical `` 3. **`api.html`: no meta description** - Defect: `index.html` has one, but `api.html` has none, so search engines will generate snippets automatically. - Evidence: the `<head>` of `api.html` contains only charset, viewport, title and canonical. 4. **`index.html`: image has no `alt` attribute** - Defect: The architecture diagram is not accessible to screen readers. It also has no text fallback if the image fails to load. - Evidence: `<img src="/diagram-architecture.svg" />` - Minor: there are no `width` or `height` attributes, which risks layout shift. 5. **`index.html`, `api.html`: no internal links between pages or navigation** - Defect: The home page doesn't link to the API reference, and the API page doesn't link back. The docs have no navigation. Users and crawlers can reach `api.html` only through the sitemap. - Evidence: the `<body>` of `index.html` contains only an `<h1>` and an `<img>`. The `<body>` of `api.html` contains only `<h1>API reference</h1>`. Neither file has an `<a>` element. ## Uncertainties (not established from the supplied files) - **Missing image file:** `index.html` references `/diagram-architecture.svg`, which is not among the supplied files. If it is not deployed, the image will 404. Please verify. - **Clean URL routing:** The canonical and sitemap use `/api`, but the file is `api.html`. This works only if the server rewrites `/api` to `api.html`. Please verify that `/api` resolves and that `/api.html` redirects to it or is otherwise handled. - **Thin API content:** `api.html` contains only a heading. This may be a placeholder, so confirm the real content is ready. - **Site-wide resources not supplied:** There is no favicon (for example `/favicon.ico`, and no `<link rel="icon">` in either page) and no custom 404 page. They may exist outside the supplied files. ## Checked and fine - `robots.txt` is valid. It disallows only `/drafts/` and points to the correct sitemap URL. - `sitemap.xml` is well-formed and its hosts match the docs host. - `index.html` has a canonical on the right host, a description, `lang`, charset and viewport.
